items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant effects
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome 2，預測細胞特異性 DNA 變異效應
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a conditional DNA sequence model that predicts how sequences and variants affect specific human cell types and states rather than averaging across tissues. Trained on over 107 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, it identified nearly twice as many causal variants (30% vs 16%) on the TenK10K immune-cell dataset. Available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, with commercial access in private preview.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGenome 2，一款條件式 DNA 序列模型，能預測序列與變異對特定人類細胞類型與狀態的影響，而非僅平均組織層級。模型在 68 種組織逾 1.07 億個細胞檔案上訓練，於 TenK10K 免疫細胞資料集上識別近兩倍的因果變異（30% 對 16%）。非商業研究可透過 AlphaGenome API 使用，商業研究則為私人預覽。
items_flat.analysis_en: Cell-type conditional prediction moves genomics from bulk averages toward mechanistic disease insights, potentially accelerating target discovery; commercial access remains limited and the model is not validated for clinical use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 細胞類型條件預測將基因組學從組織平均推向機制性病因洞察，可能加速靶點發現；商業存取仍受限，且模型尚未通過臨床驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 AlphaGenome 2，這是我們的下一代模型，能預測 DNA 序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具以揭露疾病的細胞驅動因素。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 as its most capable models for demanding technical work in coding, finance, and the sciences. Fable 5.2 is available to paid users and platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft; Mythos 5.2 requires verification for high-risk cyber and life-sciences applications. Pricing starts at $8/$40 per million tokens, with a fast mode at $16/$80; outputs are up to 30% faster than the prior version.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，作為其在編碼、金融與科學等要求極高技術工作上最有能力的模型。Fable 5.2 可供付費用戶及 AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft 等平台使用；Mythos 5.2 則需驗證才能用於高風險網路安全與生命科學應用。定價起自每百萬 tokens 8/40 美元，快速模式為 16/80 美元；輸出速度較前一版快最多 30%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Positions Anthropic’s technical-work tier with lower prices than the prior Fable 5.1 while keeping high-risk capabilities tightly controlled; sustained performance on multi-day autonomous tasks will determine real-world impact versus competitors.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Anthropic 的技術工作層級定位在較 Fable 5.1 更低價格，同時嚴格控管高風險能力；多日自主任務的持續表現將決定相對競爭對手的實際影響。
items_flat.quote: We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已升級 Claude Fable 與 Claude Mythos——這些模型專為應對最艱鉅的技術挑戰而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API and Gemini Decision 1 model
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API 與 Gemini Decision 1 模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), enabling evaluation of up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric questions in a single pass over multimodal inputs (text, images, audio, video, PDFs up to 256K tokens). It returns probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end at $0.10 per million input tokens with zero output-token charges, nearly 5x cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on shared benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 推出由新模型 Gemini Decision 1（gemini-decision-1）驅動的 Gemini Decisions API，可在單次通過中對多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF，最高 256K tokens）評估最多 1,000 個是非、選擇或量表問題。回傳機率與信心分數，端到端延遲 150-250 毫秒，每百萬輸入 tokens 0.10 美元且不計輸出 tokens，於共享基準上近乎比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 便宜 5 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Specialized scoring without token-by-token generation targets high-volume agent routing, policy checks, and grading where latency and cost dominate; adoption will hinge on calibration quality in production workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 無需逐 token 生成的專門評分，針對高流量代理路由、政策檢查與評分等延遲與成本主導的場景；實際採用將取決於生產工作流程中的校準品質。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Decisions API，這是一個由新模型 Gemini Decision 1（gemini-decision-1）驅動的快速封閉集合決策端點，可透過 Google AI Studio 中的 Gemini API 使用。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，強化現實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving dexterity, reliability, and speed across more than 200 tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept with Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids, it achieved 96% success on pick-and-pack operations. Success rates rose 30-100% and task times fell 20-30% versus prior baselines; rolling out to robotics partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最有能力的視覺-語言-動作模型，在超過 200 項任務上提升靈巧度、可靠性與速度。於 Mercedes-Benz 概念驗證中，搭配 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人在撿取包裝作業達到 96% 成功率。成功率較前基準提升 30-100%，任務時間縮短 20-30%；正逐步向機器人合作夥伴推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Gains in unstructured environments and factory pilots mark progress toward deployable physical AI, but success rates still vary widely by task and long-term robustness outside controlled settings remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 非結構化環境與工廠試點的進展標誌著可部署實體 AI 的進步，但成功率仍因任務差異大，且受控環境外的長期穩健性尚未證實。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是迄今最有能力的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes available to developers and Ultra users
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 向開發者與 Ultra 用戶開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work, available to paying developers and enterprises via the Gemini API and to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode. Introductory pricing is $2/$10 per million tokens until November 30, then $4/$20. Previously limited to cyber defenders.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 將其在網路安全與長視野代理工作上最強的模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，開放給付費開發者與企業透過 Gemini API 使用，並提供給 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini app 與 AI Mode 中使用。介紹期定價至 11 月 30 日為每百萬 tokens 2/10 美元，之後為 4/20 美元。先前僅限網路防禦者。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader access after a limited cyber-defender rollout tests whether Carbon’s higher token usage for thorough reasoning delivers net value versus Argon on production workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在有限網路防禦者推出後擴大存取，將測試 Carbon 為徹底推理而較高的 token 用量，是否在生產工作負載上相對 Argon 帶來淨價值。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，開發者可使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 進行建置，這是我們在網路安全與長時程能力上具備前沿表現的最強模型。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協定
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that, guided by Gemini agents, generated over 6 million lines of Lean proofs to mathematically verify key security properties of Signal’s cryptographic protocol code. Human experts reviewed the results; the work demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，這是一個由 Gemini 代理引導的代理框架，生成逾 600 萬行 Lean 證明，以數學方式驗證 Signal 密碼協定程式碼的關鍵安全屬性。人類專家審查結果；此工作展示 AI 輔助形式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure; scaling to larger or less modular codebases and independent audits will determine broader impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 展示 AI 輔助形式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模；擴展至更大或不那麼模組化的程式碼庫以及獨立稽核將決定更廣泛影響。
items_flat.quote: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol.
items_flat.quote_zh: Google DeepMind 研究人員引導 AI 代理，對 Signal 協議底層實際程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學證明。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow for Class A shares
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Class A 股份 IPO 路演
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The offering comprises 825 million shares (801 million by the company and the rest by existing stockholders), with an expected price range of $70–$78, implying a valuation up to about $1.4 trillion. Trading is targeted around November 19 pending SEC review.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic, PBC 啟動其擬議 Class A 普通股首次公開發行的路演。發行包含 8.25 億股（公司發行 8.01 億股，其餘由現有股東出售），預期價格區間 70–78 美元，隱含估值最高約 1.4 兆美元。交易目標約在 11 月 19 日，待 SEC 審查。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves Anthropic from private to public-market scrutiny while its S-1 remains effective only after SEC review; valuation and capital allocation between research, safety, and growth will face investor tests.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Anthropic 從私人轉向公開市場審查，而其 S-1 僅在 SEC 審查後生效；估值以及研究、安全與成長之間的資本配置將面臨投資人考驗。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 Class A 普通股擬議首次公開發行的路演。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, lightweight model for high-volume agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，輕量模型用於高流量代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for repetitive agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. Priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with 1M context and multimodal support; closed weights. Designed to pair with larger Muse models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Ember，其最小且最有效率的模型，用於工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析等重複代理工作。定價每百萬輸入 tokens 0.10 美元、輸出 0.50 美元，1M 上下文與多模態支援；權重封閉。設計為與較大 Muse 模型搭配。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targets the cost floor for the bulk of agent traffic by pairing with larger models; closed weights limit independent verification of claimed efficiency gains versus open alternatives.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 藉由與較大模型搭配，針對代理流量的成本底線；封閉權重限制對聲稱效率提升相對開放替代方案的獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行以及代理整天重複的工作而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk signals soft rollout of Grok 4.8 to Bot users
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 表示將對 Bot 用戶軟性推出 Grok 4.8
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.8 pre-training is complete, reinforcement learning is underway after rewriting the RL and inference stack in C/C++, evaluation scores are improving, and xAI will conduct a limited soft rollout to Grok Bot users later in the week of November 10. No full public or API release announced.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 表示 Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成，在以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊後正進行強化學習，評估分數正在提升，xAI 將於 11 月 10 日當週稍後對 Grok Bot 用戶進行有限軟性推出。尚未宣布完整公開或 API 發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: Executive signaling of incremental progress rather than a formal release; performance relative to Grok 4.7 and competitors will only be assessable after broader availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 高管對增量進展的訊號，而非正式發布；相對 Grok 4.7 與競爭對手的表現，僅在更廣泛可用後才能評估。
items_flat.quote: We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將於本週稍後對 Bot 用戶進行軟性推出，看看情況如何。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 毫無相似之處（幸好）。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic 2026 Usage Policy update takes effect
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 2026 使用政策更新今日生效
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s updated Usage Policy, first published in October, takes effect on November 12. Changes include a consolidated section on deceptive campaigns or artificial activity, clarified high-risk rules for health and finance requiring qualified human-in-the-loop, controls for autonomous physical actions, and a prohibition on sustained needless abusive behavior toward models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月首次發布的更新使用政策於 11 月 12 日生效。變更包括整合欺騙性活動或人工活動章節、釐清健康與金融等高風險規則（需合格人類在迴路中）、自主物理行動控管，以及禁止對模型持續無意義虐待行為。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reflects observed misuse patterns and longer autonomous agent use; enforcement consistency across enterprise customers will determine practical impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 反映觀察到的濫用模式與更長的自主代理使用；對企業客戶的執法一致性將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.
items_flat.quote_zh: 更新政策於 11 月 12 日生效。

google.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), enabling evaluation of up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric questions in a single pass over multimodal inputs (text, images, audio, video, PDFs up to 256K tokens). It returns probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end at $0.10 per million input tokens with zero output-token charges, nearly 5x cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on shared benchmarks.
google.summary_zh: Google 推出由新模型 Gemini Decision 1（gemini-decision-1）驅動的 Gemini Decisions API，可在單次通過中對多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF，最高 256K tokens）評估最多 1,000 個是非、選擇或量表問題。回傳機率與信心分數，端到端延遲 150-250 毫秒，每百萬輸入 tokens 0.10 美元且不計輸出 tokens，於共享基準上近乎比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 便宜 5 倍。
google.analysis_en: Specialized scoring without token-by-token generation targets high-volume agent routing, policy checks, and grading where latency and cost dominate; adoption will hinge on calibration quality in production workflows.
google.analysis_zh: 無需逐 token 生成的專門評分，針對高流量代理路由、政策檢查與評分等延遲與成本主導的場景；實際採用將取決於生產工作流程中的校準品質。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Decisions API，這是一個由新模型 Gemini Decision 1（gemini-decision-1）驅動的快速封閉集合決策端點，可透過 Google AI Studio 中的 Gemini API 使用。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for real-world dexterity
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，強化現實世界靈巧度
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving dexterity, reliability, and speed across more than 200 tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept with Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids, it achieved 96% success on pick-and-pack operations. Success rates rose 30-100% and task times fell 20-30% versus prior baselines; rolling out to robotics partners.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最有能力的視覺-語言-動作模型，在超過 200 項任務上提升靈巧度、可靠性與速度。於 Mercedes-Benz 概念驗證中，搭配 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人在撿取包裝作業達到 96% 成功率。成功率較前基準提升 30-100%，任務時間縮短 20-30%；正逐步向機器人合作夥伴推出。
google.analysis_en: Gains in unstructured environments and factory pilots mark progress toward deployable physical AI, but success rates still vary widely by task and long-term robustness outside controlled settings remains unproven.
google.analysis_zh: 非結構化環境與工廠試點的進展標誌著可部署實體 AI 的進步，但成功率仍因任務差異大，且受控環境外的長期穩健性尚未證實。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是迄今最有能力的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型。

google.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes available to developers and Ultra users
google.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 向開發者與 Ultra 用戶開放
google.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work, available to paying developers and enterprises via the Gemini API and to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode. Introductory pricing is $2/$10 per million tokens until November 30, then $4/$20. Previously limited to cyber defenders.
google.summary_zh: Google 將其在網路安全與長視野代理工作上最強的模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，開放給付費開發者與企業透過 Gemini API 使用，並提供給 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini app 與 AI Mode 中使用。介紹期定價至 11 月 30 日為每百萬 tokens 2/10 美元，之後為 4/20 美元。先前僅限網路防禦者。
google.analysis_en: Broader access after a limited cyber-defender rollout tests whether Carbon’s higher token usage for thorough reasoning delivers net value versus Argon on production workloads.
google.analysis_zh: 在有限網路防禦者推出後擴大存取，將測試 Carbon 為徹底推理而較高的 token 用量，是否在生產工作負載上相對 Argon 帶來淨價值。
google.quote: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
google.quote_zh: 即日起，開發者可使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 進行建置，這是我們在網路安全與長時程能力上具備前沿表現的最強模型。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協定
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that, guided by Gemini agents, generated over 6 million lines of Lean proofs to mathematically verify key security properties of Signal’s cryptographic protocol code. Human experts reviewed the results; the work demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，這是一個由 Gemini 代理引導的代理框架，生成逾 600 萬行 Lean 證明，以數學方式驗證 Signal 密碼協定程式碼的關鍵安全屬性。人類專家審查結果；此工作展示 AI 輔助形式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模。
google.analysis_en: Demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure; scaling to larger or less modular codebases and independent audits will determine broader impact.
google.analysis_zh: 展示 AI 輔助形式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模；擴展至更大或不那麼模組化的程式碼庫以及獨立稽核將決定更廣泛影響。
google.quote: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol.
google.quote_zh: Google DeepMind 研究人員引導 AI 代理，對 Signal 協議底層實際程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學證明。

meta.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, lightweight model for high-volume agent tasks
meta.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，輕量模型用於高流量代理任務
meta.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for repetitive agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. Priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with 1M context and multimodal support; closed weights. Designed to pair with larger Muse models.
meta.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Ember，其最小且最有效率的模型，用於工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析等重複代理工作。定價每百萬輸入 tokens 0.10 美元、輸出 0.50 美元，1M 上下文與多模態支援；權重封閉。設計為與較大 Muse 模型搭配。
meta.analysis_en: Targets the cost floor for the bulk of agent traffic by pairing with larger models; closed weights limit independent verification of claimed efficiency gains versus open alternatives.
meta.analysis_zh: 藉由與較大模型搭配，針對代理流量的成本底線；封閉權重限制對聲稱效率提升相對開放替代方案的獨立驗證。
meta.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
meta.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行以及代理整天重複的工作而設計。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk signals soft rollout of Grok 4.8 to Bot users
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk 表示將對 Bot 用戶軟性推出 Grok 4.8
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.8 pre-training is complete, reinforcement learning is underway after rewriting the RL and inference stack in C/C++, evaluation scores are improving, and xAI will conduct a limited soft rollout to Grok Bot users later in the week of November 10. No full public or API release announced.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 表示 Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成，在以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊後正進行強化學習，評估分數正在提升，xAI 將於 11 月 10 日當週稍後對 Grok Bot 用戶進行有限軟性推出。尚未宣布完整公開或 API 發布。
xai.analysis_en: Executive signaling of incremental progress rather than a formal release; performance relative to Grok 4.7 and competitors will only be assessable after broader availability.
xai.analysis_zh: 高管對增量進展的訊號，而非正式發布；相對 Grok 4.7 與競爭對手的表現，僅在更廣泛可用後才能評估。
xai.quote: We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
xai.quote_zh: 我們將於本週稍後對 Bot 用戶進行軟性推出，看看情況如何。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 毫無相似之處（幸好）。

brief_en: Google DeepMind ships AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant prediction and Gemini Decision 1 for fast closed-set multimodal scoring. Anthropic’s updated Usage Policy takes effect; Claude Fable/Mythos 5.2 and Gemini Robotics 2.5 remain the week’s flagship technical releases.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 推出細胞特異性 DNA 變異預測模型 AlphaGenome 2，以及快速封閉集合多模態評分的 Gemini Decision 1。Anthropic 更新使用政策今日生效；Claude Fable/Mythos 5.2 與 Gemini Robotics 2.5 仍是本週旗艦技術發布。
